definitions.explanation: The quantitative relation between two amounts.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}の{割合|わりあい}は3{対|たい}2だ。
examples.english: The ratio of men to women is 3 to 2.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}の{割合|わりあい}が{高|たか}い。
この{問題|もんだい}は{割合|わりあい}{簡単|かんたん}だ。

notes:
{割合|わりあい} is composed of {割|わり} (divide) + {合|あい} (match).

USAGE:
As noun:
- ～の{割合|わりあい}: the ratio/proportion of ~
- {割合|わりあい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: the ratio is high/low

As adverb:
- {割合|わりあい} + adjective: relatively/fairly ~
- Similar to {比較的|ひかくてき} (comparatively)
